description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
The Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
